label: Card Insight
title: Card Insight
summary: Use a Card Insight to show one finding about someone's money: a title, a status badge, one figure, and a hint on what to do next.
corePrinciple: One finding, one figure, one hint.

anatomy.title: A finding, its figure, and a hint
anatomy.description: A white card puts a title, one line of context, and a badge on top. Below sit the figure, here a Savings Goal Summary, and a footer under a divider: a hint with one action.
blocks: The topic in 16 px bold; it wraps rather than cutting off.
One sentence of context at 12 px.
A string becomes a Badge; false removes it.
children: here a Savings Goal Summary with a bar and two legend rows.
A 1 px rule, shown only with a footer.
A hint and one action, set with footerBody and footerButtonLabel; false removes it.
specimen: Four of the eight months we suggest.
Add ₹10,000 a month to reach it by June.

configuration.title: Brand colour
configuration.description: AppearanceBrand colours the badge and the bar: Primary gold by default, Secondary purple as in Figma, Tertiary blue, or Neutral grey. The footer is grey with a dark button, as in Figma, until you set AppearanceBrand on the card; then it takes that colour too. The card, its title, and its subtitle stay the same. badge takes a string, your own node, or false; children replaces the figure, and footer takes your own node or false.

content.title: Name the finding, then the hint
content.description: Name the topic in the title and add one sentence of context. The badge is a one- or two-word status, such as “On track”, that doesn't repeat the title. Give the footer one hint and at most one action, labelled with a verb.
blocks: “Emergency savings”, how far along it is, “On track”, and one way to get there.

sources.title: Use the public Card Insight contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (23 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Card/Insight is one 356 × 322 component with a title, a subtitle, and a slot; its badge, divider, and footer are fixed, its badge is green, and its bar is purple, while the package defaults to gold. The default footer shows Figma’s placeholder hint and “Button”; set its hint, button label, and action, as these examples do. The default figure’s caption, “Credit usage”, reads on the white card, and the bar keeps its fill at every Emphasis. A System badge’s label is white, as in Figma. The published Storybook predates this build.
